test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some tunes are songs.

All tunes are melodies.

**Conclusions**:

I. No song is a melody.

II. All songs are melodies.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Statements:**

Some tunes are songs.

All tunes are melodies.

**Possible Venn diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3f587f2476057730dd2ba864640bab7901390aa6c2eeb01a18d5b7f689c9029.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No song is a melody → **False **(As all tunes are melodies and some songs are melodies so, no song is melody is not definite true)

II. All songs are melodies →** False** (As all tunes are melodies and some songs are melodies so, all songs are melodies is possible but not definite true)

**Thus, neither conclusion I nor II follows**.

Hence,** 'option 1'** is the correct answer.
